about_the_game:
Slide into Action!

A soldier on roller skates. A kingdom overrun with monsters.

It’s a new twist on sliding block puzzles! It’s not about reaching the goal, just hitting the targets. 

This knight doesn’t have brakes, so pick your targets and plan your moves cause there’s no stopping once you start!

Slide Smart

Slide through 4000 pre-generated levels ranging from easy to hard! Perfectionist? Discover the perfect path in every level.

Want to explore? Try Adventure mode and slide into the densest part of the forest. You can’t see as far, so you’ll have to follow your trail to know where you’ve been.

Chill Puzzle Solving

Solve puzzles at your own pace.

No timer keeps things chill and relaxing so you can take your time and enjoy the music.  As you play, the forest shifts through the seasons keeping things visually fresh but familiar.

Game Features

  • 4000 pre-generated levels

  • Fast sliding action. You only stop when you hit a wall

  • Relaxed gameplay. You can aim for perfection or just enjoy the journey

  • Adventure Mode: The same core mechanics but with a focus on exploration and discovery 

  • Relaxing soundtrack

  • Chill hand-drawn art style

Make your Move

You’ve got your wheels, now take back control of the kingdom! Wishlist it today!
